mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within 5 trading days signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units and rise in consumer inflation above 2.5% annually signals a demand shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500 and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production below 99.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past 3 months supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1500 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in residential demand that typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a declining unemployment rate signals an overheating economy with tightening monetary policy, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
